summary:
ANIMA MASTER v7 is the maximal ANIMA lineage: an ERC-721 (IDontFuckingBelieveIt, 20,940 bytes) whose tokens each get a deterministic CREATE2 SovereignAccount (custom, explicitly not canonical ERC-6551), a ConfluenceRenderer whose tokenURI emits a data:text/html boot page that recovers an entire 7,952,983-byte web application from immutable AppChunk contracts (101 chunks in 20 gzip feature archives under an OnchainModuleDirectory), and since v7 an owner-installable module system (ModuleArchiveFactory, ExtensionReleaseRegistry, TokenModuleRegistry, ModuleStateStore, ModuleWorkbench, ChunkedCartridgeRegistry). Around that core it bundles 204 compiled artifacts covering a Uniswap v4 launchpad, an internal AMM (NativeMarket), a community sale (GenesisLaunchpad), streaming auctions, TimeVault/VestedExitVault, EpochGroupChat/MLSGroupChat, LayerZero witnesses, RAILGUN shielded execution, governance, experimental markets and more; system-manifest.json lists 56 modules, several marked LOCAL_SERVICE_AND_CONTRACTS or RESEARCH_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

The pipeline is Node-only: scripts/compile.mjs (solc-js 0.8.30, viaIR, optimizer 1000, Cancun default / Shanghai for local fixtures, EIP-170 gate, atomic artifact swap, contract-sizes.json), scripts/build-confluence.mjs (16 generator scripts + 3 package builds composing dist/index.html and dist/modules.html from authored web/ modules), scripts/archive-confluence.mjs (schema 3 modular-gzip archive) and scripts/verify-confluence.mjs (byte-exact recovery, data:-only import map, node --check). scripts/master-local.mjs is the v7 entry: persistent Ganache 31337 (Shanghai, 100M block gas), deployGenesis (approx. 40 contracts, commit/reveal mint with 25 ETH endowment, sealed GenesisManifest, seeded market, recoverArchive round-trip), deployModuleSystem, three example modules installed through SovereignAccount.execute, a 48 KiB cartridge acquired by the NFT account, and recovery verified before printing the workbench URL. scripts/validate-release.mjs runs a 24-stage gate with candidate-input fingerprinting and 'incomplete is not pass' test-summary parsing; CI has three jobs (complete local suite, Chromium browser, native Forge). Deployment to public chains is planner-based and unsigned (genesis-deployment, modules-deployment, extensions-deployment, v4-deployment) except scripts/sepolia.mjs, a Sepolia-only resumable runner with journaled receipts, ArchiveCreated postcondition checks and literal --confirm tokens.

Claimed verification (GitHub Actions run 35172184548 on commit 84961c3): 24/24 stages, 760/760 root JS tests, 11 official-launch, 1 MLS, 9 Rust, 51 module tests, 7 native Forge tests + 64 fuzz runs, 17 Chromium scenarios (Chromium 151.0.7922.34) including a full minted-runtime acceptance with 7 reviewed transactions, 32 KiB state writes at 7,871,459 gas under the 16,777,216 EIP-7825 cap, workbench 707,014 bytes / 31 chunks. On main the only deployment is local chain 31337; packaging.json says publicChainDeployed:false. A side branch (origin/codex/deploy-on-testnet-and-mint-3-nfts-pj8cqs, commit 33f1034) records a live Ethereum Sepolia deployment: collection 0xCB8Dc18d3Ca5C9c2aeA16c94fa0af6EF4dfc0aC6, three minted tokens, full module system, 37 module transactions in blocks 11742089-11742148. No audit, no funded RAILGUN/LayerZero, no mainnet.

For the GOAL: the website is delivered from chain through tokenURI's animation_url (loader stored in an AppChunk created by the renderer constructor and copied with extcodecopy; hand-rolled SHA-256 because SubtleCrypto is unavailable in opaque data: origins; pinned-block eth_call recovery; document.write). There is no web3:// (ERC-4804/6860) resolver; the project's own standards review says so. Ownership gating is a client-side check (ownerOf == signer at one block, bound to the token's embedded AWE_CHAIN_IDENTITY, re-checked with sessionEpoch before every send, workbench additionally requires SovereignAccount.currentOwner == ownerOf) plus contract-side enforcement (Bound-mode execute resolves ownerOf at call time; TokenModuleRegistry requires the canonical account, catalog root and custody epoch). Reads are open to anyone with an RPC.

unique_ideas: Recovery loader stored in an AppChunk created by the renderer constructor and copied with extcodecopy so tokenURI's animation_url bootstraps without spending EIP-170 runtime bytes
Hand-rolled SHA-256 in the loader because SubtleCrypto is unavailable in opaque data: URL origins
Schema-3 functional feature archives: 20 independently versioned gzip archives under an OnchainModuleDirectory whose commitment excludes addresses so unchanged features are reused across editions
Per-NFT module registry with append-only catalog roots, custody-epoch binding, staged migrations; 32 KiB state stored as AppChunk code to fit EIP-7825 (7.87 M gas measured)
Validation runner with candidate-input fingerprinting and 'skipped/todo/cancelled = incomplete, not pass' summary parsing; evidence directories outside the inventory
Unsigned plan + --verify reconstruction + journaled resumable runner with ArchiveCreated postcondition checks and literal --confirm tokens
ReviewedAction pattern: prepare/simulate/show exact calldata and gas, recheck owner+epoch+root immediately before a single send; revision counters kill stale previews
Cartridge ERC-721 acquired by the NFT's own account (nested ownership without ERC-7401)
Generated capability inventory with an 'actual boundary' column shared by docs and the in-app Atlas
weaknesses: No web3:// surface; the website is a data: URI opened via animation_url and recovery is eager (~8 MB expanded, 2 MB stored, 101 chunks); tokenURI reads in fixtures need gasLimit 90,000,000

Custom account rather than canonical ERC-6551; no ERC-7401; unverified ERC-8004 binding; supportsInterface advertises no execution interface
Enormous surface (204 artifacts, 56 modules, RAILGUN 15 MB worker with 51 advisories, LayerZero, Groth16 dev setup, Rust kernel, Python render parity) — much marked local-service or research
Shared ModuleArchiveFactory CREATE-nonce race between planning and signing is detected, not prevented
Direct module state capped at 32 KiB; all unencrypted bytes public; no key handover on NFT transfer

website_delivery: From chain, via tokenURI only. ConfluenceRenderer.render returns data:application/json;base64 whose animation_url is data:text/html;base64 of a boot page = <script>window.AWE_CHAIN_IDENTITY={seed,genome,root,chainId,collection,tokenId,manifest,privacyResource,runtime,sha256,archiveVersion}</script> plus a ~15 KB loader HTML copied with extcodecopy from an AppChunk the renderer constructor created from ConfluenceLoader.html() (generated from web/confluence/chain-loader.mjs + module-loader.mjs). The loader offers 'Unfold my artifact' using window.ethereum or an entered HTTPS/loopback RPC, checks eth_chainId, pins eth_blockNumber, reads the OnchainModuleDirectory then each of 20 feature archives (readChunk eth_calls, 23,000-byte chunks, 101 chunks), gunzips, verifies SHA-256 with a hand-rolled implementation, builds an import map of data:text/javascript;base64 modules and document.write()s the 7,952,983-byte app. The companion module workbench (707,014 bytes, 31 chunks) is anchored by ModuleWorkbench.services()/readChunk and recovered by CLI then served from a trusted local origin (also embedded in the app as the modules@8 feature). There is NO web3:// (ERC-4804/6860) resolver, no resolveMode, no path routing — the project's own standards.md says 'has no manual resolver, raw-path fallback, index route, asset routing, or web3 client integration'. dist/index.html served by scripts/serve-confluence.mjs on 127.0.0.1:4173 (or GitHub Pages in the sibling repo) is a hosted convenience, not the delivery path. The RAILGUN worker, circuits, RPC, Waku, keepers and world servers remain external.
wallet_gating: Reads are open to anyone with an RPC (unfold the artifact, participant launch pages, module/state recovery). Access to owner actions is gated client-side and enforced contract-side. Original app (web/confluence/wallet.mjs:47-100): assertMintBinding(window.AWE_CHAIN_IDENTITY, collection, tokenId[, chainId]) refuses another collection/token/chain; eth_requestAccounts; at one block ownerOf/accountOf/renderSnapshot; owner !== signer => 'This wallet does not own the selected NFT.'; account must have code; refresh() re-reads ownerOf/accountOf/eth_chainId/eth_accounts at one block and invalidates on mismatch; accountsChanged/chainChanged invalidate; every prepared review captures SovereignAccount.sessionEpoch and rechecks it before signing. Workbench (web/modules/adapter.mjs:11-22): readRegistry must return collection==wallet.collection, account==wallet.account, owner==wallet.address and SovereignAccount.currentOwner()==owner, else 'Registry identity or current NFT custody does not match.'; fresh() re-asserts sameAuthority (chainId/registry/collection/tokenId/account/owner/epoch) immediately before each send and that the release is still enabled. Contracts: Bound-mode SovereignAccount.execute resolves ownerOf(tokenId) at call time (authority follows transfer); TokenModuleRegistry activate/writeState/stageState/disable require msg.sender == accountOf(tokenId), the expected catalog root and the current sessionEpoch; custody-changing callbacks roll back delegated execution. 'Authorised by the holder' exists at contract level (token approval, operator approval, narrow session keys with exact target/selector/value/window/count/epoch, exact-calldata instrument grants with net-debit budgets, SessionSponsor vouchers, AgentPolicyGuard), but the shipped UI recipes require the exact owner in Bound mode and 'Proof-authorized account mode ... is intentionally rejected by this adapter'. Browser fixtures use an injected EIP-1193 provider and explicitly do not prove real ownership.

Telling tests: 'real v4 atomic allocations, TimeVault custody, discoverable records and failure recovery'; 'native NFT owns module selection, atomic state migration, stale reviews and transfer revocation'; 'a real minted NFT embeds the immutable schema3 loader and its exact onchain feature edition'; 'the unsigned sequence executes on an isolated EVM with exact archives, complete constructor wiring and immutable manifest'; 'Sepolia archive receipt verification rejects a front-run address substitution'; 'maximum direct state and chunk boundaries recover exactly within the transaction gas cap'; 'minted owners cannot substitute another token, collection or network'.
